plugins.name: lode
plugins.description: [code] Worklode: worktree-bound task pickup for agents. Slash commands /lode:next|resume|done|block|status wrap the lode CLI to claim a ready task, create its worktree under .worktrees/, bind the lease, and hand it off for review or record it blocked. /lode:spec-coverage finds accepted specs with sections no accepted plan covers and seeds a planning task for each; /lode:plan-spec decomposes an accepted spec into plans under a claimed design task. The `worklode` skill is a model-invocable orientation reference for any project Worklode manages — entities, edges, the task state machine, the doc model, the full command catalog — meant to be pointed at from a project's own CLAUDE.md. Lifecycle hooks ship with the CLI, not here: `lode install` writes them per repo into each targeted coding agent's own configuration, alongside the git hooks and the AGENTS.md block, so they stay versioned with the binary.
